g.text: B5 | Native steady gates, pressure drop, integrated force and mesh comparison
One baseline and at most one refinement; original unobstructed CFD reused. All tractions use only the exposed clot boundary.
A two-mesh engineering screen is separate from contact-line peak convergence, clinical validity, streaming and two-way FSI.
